title.en: Central Provident Fund (Home Protection Insurance Scheme — Exemption) Notification 1985

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Central Provident Fund (Home Protection Insurance Scheme — Exemption) Notification 1985.

heading.en: Exemption from Home Protection Insurance Scheme

text.en: 2. Any member who has purchased a house or flat from a Housing Authority and has withdrawn any moneys from the Fund under the Central Provident Fund (Residential Properties Scheme) Regulations 1982 for all or any of the purposes set out in section 21(1) of the Act is exempt from the Home Protection Insurance Scheme established under section 29 of the Act.
